title: Geometric-series inverse in a complete normed ring
statement: Let $B$ be a unital ring with a norm taking values in the usual ordered field $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], satisfying $\|b\|=0\Leftrightarrow b=0$, $\|-b\|=\|b\|$, $\|b+c\|\le\|b\|+\|c\|$ and $\|bc\|\le\|b\|\|c\|$. Assume that the metric $d(b,c)=\|b-c\|$ is complete. For every $h\in B$ with $\|h\|<1$, the geometric series $\sum_{n\ge0}h^n$ converges to a two-sided inverse of $1-h$. In particular $1-h$ is a unit. No commutativity or scalar-field hypothesis is required.
